comparison.objective: Bleed air from a brake caliper without drawing air back in.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate pedal hold/release with repeated wrench opening and closing of a bleeder in a strict temporal sequence.
comparison.success_condition: Residual air meets thresholds, bleeder is shut before every pedal return, pedal and wrench finish released and settled, and no air re-entry occurs.
comparison.reason: It shares iterative adjustment and sequencing, but its core ability is fluid purging through synchronized valve/pedal cycles, not commissioning an impact absorber.
